meta.description: Blind messy test set: 22 failure categories x 4 reports. Synthetic only. Text written by a persona-prompted LLM (not the parser's model). Batch 2 (BL45-BL88) adds more emoji, empty and emoji-only messages. Do not run any parser on this file before the labels in data/blind_review.csv are reviewed.

reports.persona: 70-year-old grandfather who loves to tell stories
reports.scenario_hint: About 250-300 words about grandkids, the weather, parking at the hospital, the TV show; ONE symptom buried in the middle: threw up once after lunch.
reports.text: well it was a long one actually. the grandkids came over to see the goldfish again, little sammy kept trying to feed them crackers, you know how they are, so dizzy and all that. had to explain that fish don't eat bread, they get the gills all clogged up, reminded me of when i dropped my pipe down the drain in '98, took me an hour to get it back, old rags and a wire hanger, but we digress. weather has been so damp lately, that grey mist that gets into your joints, my knees feel like rusty hinges, really do. but the real headache was dropping them off at st. vincent for their physicals, i swear they changed the parking layout again, nothing marked, just cones and confusion, i circled the block three times looking for the handicap spot, saw a taxi driver sitting in it eating a sandwich, i wanted to shout at him but i was too tired. went in to wait anyway, sat in that uncomfortable plastic chair with the armrests broken. turned on the news but it was just rain again, so i put on that show with the detective, the one with the old dog, really good acting, quite moving actually. then i went home, had a bit of lunch, just toast and some tea maybe. and right after, felt a wave come on, kinda heavy in the stomach, and then i threw up once, just once, into the sink. wiped it up, drank some water, sat on the couch for a while. not great but manageable i guess. anyway, sammy sent a drawing of his daddy, pretty good, two eyes and a smile, i put it on the fridge. hope you are all well. bob.

reports.persona: 70-year-old grandfather who loves to tell stories
reports.scenario_hint: About 250-300 words rambling about his garden and neighbours; buried in the middle: nausea in the evening and skipped dinner.
reports.text: morning here. the roses are doing alright, the ruddy ones by the gate are blooming nice, really happy about that, but the hydrangeas are a mess, all droopy and brown on the edges, i think the bees took everything they could get. spent half the day out there with the hose, trying not to overdo it because my back gets cranky if i bend too long, got my knee brace on just in case. neighbor harry is up to his usual tricks, i hear him mowing the lawn at seven in the morning, that loud engine really grates on me, makes the whole street shake, i waved but he didn't even look up, typical harry, thinks the whole world revolves around his perfect hedge. i waved at mary next door, she gave me a bowl of zucchini, too many zucchini, i have a fridge full of them now, dont know what to do with them, maybe zucchini bread if i have the energy later. afternoon was quiet, just sat on the porch reading the paper, the news is terrible as usual but i try to look on the bright side. evening came in and the air turned cold, got a bit of a queasy feeling in the middle of the evening, kind of a rolling motion in the stomach, not exactly throwing up but enough to make me not want to touch the food. so i skipped dinner, just had a dry cracker and some water, felt better after that. went to bed early, slept like a rock, woke up early this morning. anyway, the garden needs weeding but i might wait until tomorrow, its too windy today for it.

reports.persona: 70-year-old grandfather who loves to tell stories
reports.scenario_hint: About 250 words with lots of emoji about a family birthday party and a cake; buried in the middle: couldn't keep any water down since this morning.
reports.text: hey doc its me george again 🎂🎈🎉 so you have to hear about this thing that happened yesterday at the family get together it was sarahs 40th birthday and oh my god the whole house was packed with people i love them all so much ❤️😍 we had this huge spread of food that my daughter made she is such a cook 🍰🥗🍗 and then she brought out this massive three-tiered birthday cake with all those little candles on top 🕯️✨ it smelled like vanilla and heaven 🎶😇 everyone started singing happy birthday and i almost cried i mean i did cry a little bit 🥲😭 but it was a happy cry not a sad one i was so proud of her she is such a good daughter 🥰👩‍👧 and her little boy was running around acting like a maniac 🐶😜 he even gave me a hug which is rare for him 🫂💖 anyway i tried to eat two slices of that cake because who says no to a birthday surprise 🍽️😋 but honestly my stomach was already acting up before i even started eating i felt queasy sitting there laughing with everyone 🤢😅 i kept trying to smile and pretend everything was fine because i did not want to ruin the party for anybody 💪✨ so i went to the bathroom a few times just to check on things but it was nothing just some general discomfort maybe i ate too fast or something 🤷‍♂️🍽️ and then here is the thing i have to tell you because i need to be honest i could not keep any water down since this morning 🚱🤮 i tried sips and tiny sips but it just all came back up or made me feel like i was going to explode 💥😖 i am sure i will be fine by the time i see you next week but i just wanted to get that logged in the system before i forget about it 📝🧠 thanks for listening to my story 🥰📱

reports.persona: 70-year-old grandfather who loves to tell stories
reports.scenario_hint: About 250 words about his dog, the vet and the neighbour's fence; buried in the middle: dry heaved a few times last night but didn't actually throw up.
reports.text: morning dear its friday and i am sitting here with my coffee ☕😌 (mostly just watching it actually) and i just wanted to update you on the situation with buster 🐕💔 he has been so weird this week i know it is probably just stress but he won t stop sneezing 🤧💨 i took him to the vet dr rachel was very kind and gave him some new meds 💊🩺 she said it was probably just an allergy to something in the garden which makes sense because we have started mowing the lawn again 🌱✂️ but here is the part that is really getting to me his relationship with old mr thompson next door has become quite tense 🐶🚫🔪 or at least that is what i think because buster keeps barking at the fence line for hours at a time 🗣️😡 i tried talking to thompson to see if he could keep his cat off the property 🐈‍⬛🚫 but the man just looked at me over his glasses and shook his head like i was being unreasonable 🙄🕶️ so now i am stuck dealing with my dog s anxiety and my neighbor s attitude at the same time which is a lot for a 70 year old man to handle on a tuesday 📅😫 i really hope the vet pills work because i cannot watch him be so agitated all the time 🥺💊 it makes the whole house feel so loud and chaotic 🏠🌪️ anyway i just wanted to let you know that i am managing the stress but it is wearing me down 📉🧠 i am going to try to keep him occupied with some walks in the park this afternoon if the weather holds up ☀️🌳 we will see how he reacts to the fresh air 🍃💨 if he settles down then i will not worry about it anymore but if he starts barking again i might have to install a new fence panel just to make him feel secure 🚧🔨 it is a silly thing to worry about when you are in treatment but it is my dog and i care about him a lot ❤️🐾 i hope you have a good day 💐
